Disneyland birthday game plan

Before travel: Install Tokyo Disney Resort app, sign in and link all four tickets. Check ride height requirements and scheduled closures.

On entering: Check live wait times. Consider paid Premier Access for Beauty and the Beast (¥2,500 each) and Baymax (¥1,500 each), if available. Access is sold in the park app after you enter, and can sell out. Pooh’s Hunny Hunt (about ¥1,500) and Monsters, Inc. (about ¥1,000) are now Premier Access too, since the free Priority Pass ended in August 2026.

Morning: Beauty and the Beast, Pooh’s Hunny Hunt and Monsters, Inc. Ride & Go Seek! Pick based on queues and location.

Afternoon: Baymax, family-friendly rides, lunch and the Christmas parade. Check the actual parade time in the app.

Birthday: Ask any Cast Member for Phoenix’s complimentary birthday sticker. Ask at the restaurant about a birthday decoration with the meal.

Evening: Dinner, illuminated castle and Electrical Parade if operating, then return before everyone is exhausted.

Official guide: Premier Access details · Tokyo Disney Resort app

Optional

Birthday extras to check

Ask a Cast Member for Phoenix’s birthday sticker, choose a birthday meal or treat and check the Tokyo Disney Resort app for parade and evening-show times. Reserve priority attractions through the app when eligible, after park entry.

Disneyland ticket already purchased. Attractions, show times and Premier Access are subject to availability.

How to buy the Karuizawa bullet train tickets

Book now: JR East Train Reservation (official). Tickets go on sale at 10am Japan time one month before travel, so 11 December seats are on sale now.

Outbound: Tokyo → Karuizawa, Friday 11 December 2026. Select a Hokuriku Shinkansen service that actually stops at Karuizawa (such as Asama or selected Hakutaka trains). The 06:52 Asama 601 fits the 06:20 start; the 06:44 Hakutaka 661 is faster.

Return: Karuizawa → Tokyo, same day, after your snow activities. Reserve four seats together. Enter the children's correct ages.

Collect/board: Choose paper ticket collection at a JR East station or link each traveller's eligible Suica/PASMO card to a shinkansen e-ticket. Ordinary subway travel to Tokyo Station is separate.

Wednesday railway museum: A shinkansen is optional for the short Tokyo → Omiya journey. A regular JR train is simpler and avoids an additional bullet train booking.

If plans change

Other good kid days

Ideas to swap in, not extras. The plan is already full.

  • KidZania Tokyo, Toyosu: children try real-world jobs in a miniature city. Allow half a day; replace another activity.
  • Warner Bros. Studio Tour Tokyo, Nerima: Harry Potter sets and behind-the-scenes experiences. Allow 3–4 hours plus travel; advance booking needed.
  • Tokyo Dome City Attractions: Ferris wheel and family rides, with evening lights. Allow 1–2 hours; good as a flexible evening.
  • Sanrio Puroland: indoor Hello Kitty and Sanrio character park. A separate half or full day, not a quick stop.
  • Tokyo DisneySea: a second full theme park with Fantasy Springs (Frozen, Tangled and Peter Pan). Only add by replacing a full day, not after Disneyland.

Priority: keep Sumoland, teamLab, Disneyland, snow and the Railway Museum. Choose one or two of the above only if they match the children’s interests.

Notes marked “Checked 21 Nov” were verified against official sites on 21 November 2026. Prices and times change; recheck the week before. Nothing here is a booking.
